capabilities: Create root, affix and word entries stored as editable Markdown notes with frontmatter
Associate a single word with multiple roots
Search entries by spelling, Chinese meaning, root form and variants
Filter words by familiarity and favorites
Look up Chinese definitions from a local ECDICT CSV file
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian desktop). Chinese lookup needs ecdict.csv downloaded separately and placed in the vault or a configured path; no network requests are made. Familiarity and favorites are for filtering only, not review scheduling. README is bilingual (English and Chinese).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to structure English root/affix word families, track familiarity, or look up Chinese meanings while keeping entries as editable Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: Chinese meaning lookup uses the local ECDICT dataset and does not send words to an online translation service.

summary: Vocabulary study tool that organizes English roots, affixes and words as Markdown notes with search, familiarity marking and local Chinese definitions.
